_comment: Core 10e targeting restrictions for ranged attacks. Look Out Sir is a universal core rule that protects non-MONSTER/VEHICLE CHARACTERS shielded by a nearby unit. Lone Operative is a unit-level ability granted to specific datasheets (Eliminators, Lictors, Callidus Assassins, etc.) that hard-caps ranged targeting to within 12".

simulator.look_out_sir.quoted_text: Each time a Character unit (excluding Monster and Vehicle units) is targeted by a ranged attack, if a friendly non-Character unit is within 3" of that Character unit, the ranged attack cannot be made unless the attacking unit is within 12" of the target.
simulator.look_out_sir.trigger: ranged attack targets a non-MONSTER/non-VEHICLE CHARACTER unit, friendly non-CHARACTER unit within 3" of the target, attacker >12" away
simulator.look_out_sir.effect: the ranged attack cannot be made (target invalid)

simulator.lone_operative.quoted_text: A unit with this ability can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 12" of it.
simulator.lone_operative.trigger: ranged attack targets a unit with the Lone Operative ability, attacker >12" away
simulator.lone_operative.effect: the ranged attack cannot be made (target invalid)
